$comment: Pi models.json for Ollama Cloud. Copy to ~/.pi/agent/models.json (or merge
into an existing one) so Pi itself runs on the same open-weight models the
decision gate uses. Requires OLLAMA_API_KEY in the environment that starts Pi.
Model names come from https://ollama.com/api/tags; check `dspy-jev models --live`
before pinning one, since Ollama retires cloud models.
